summary: Byte-property setter (thiscall): writes the byte value a3 into the object at byte offset (a2 + 636) and returns a3. Operates on a byte-indexed property region whose base lies at offset 636 (0x27C) of the caller-supplied object.

operations.description: Store byte a3 at this[a2 + 636]: the caller-supplied byte value is written into the byte property indexed by a2 at base offset 636 of the object.
Return a3 in the low byte of the result (LOBYTE(result) = a3), propagating the written value to the caller.
Invoked by SwapAndReinit (0x00452740), ConditionalCollisionDispatch (0x004527C0) and CameraViewportConfigBatch (0x00453560) to set individual byte properties in the object's 636-offset region.
